messages.subject: pileup2acgt: strand and indels
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am using the "pileup2acgt" command from sequenza-utils in combination with samtools mpileup, in order to check which bases are found at each position of the genome and in which proportion.

My command is:
samtools mpileup -Q 20 -f GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa file.bam | python sequenza-utils.py pileup2acgt - > file_sequenza.txt

I have a few of questions regarding the output:

* I don't really understand the last column ("strand") of the output: how can I interpret it?
* Regarding strands again: to my understanding, samtools mpileup outputs "." or ","  according to whether a base is mapped on the forward or reverse strand, respectively. Is this information lost on the output of pileup2acgt? Or can I extract somehow from the "strand" column?
* Finally, I am wondering if there is a way for pileup2acgt (or another program from the sequenza suite of tools) to also output information about deletions and insertions at each position.

Best regards,
Sarah
